note: Rod ladder re-read from Oct 4–5, 2026 shop footage (G0Dx fresh-account run + Maskednoobgy live). Cash prices with priceVerified=true were read directly off the in-game Rods shop. priceVerified=false = rod exists but price is unconfirmed, Robux-only, event/spin-wheel only, or no longer in the shop — those are excluded from the calculator.

rods.name: Starter Rod
rods.note: The rod you spawn with: x1.00 reel, 10 kg. Swap it for the Stone Rod as soon as you can afford it.

rods.name: Stone Rod
rods.note: First real upgrade: x1.10 reel, 20 kg. Cheap enough that there's no reason to wait.

rods.name: Golden Rod
rods.note: x1.22 reel, 40 kg for $2,500 (Oct 4 shop). Pairs well with your first hole-size upgrades.

rods.name: Cactus Rod
rods.note: x1.36 reel, 80 kg for $7,500 (Oct 4 shop). The last of the cheap starter rods — buy it, then start saving.

rods.name: Tree Rod
rods.note: x1.52 reel, 150 kg. Sits between Cactus ($7,500) and Knight ($150,000); the Oct footage only shows it already owned, so the exact price isn't read yet.

rods.name: Knight Rod
rods.note: x1.70 reel, 300 kg for $150,000. A lobby pedestal also sells it for R$79 if you'd rather skip the grind.

rods.name: Magma Rod
rods.note: x1.90 reel, 600 kg for $650,000 (Oct 4 shop). Doubles your capacity over Knight.

rods.name: Pirate Rod
rods.note: x2.15 reel, 1,200 kg for $2M. Big jump — this is where turtles and big sharks stop escaping.

rods.name: Magic Rod
rods.note: x2.45 reel, 2,000 kg. Shooting-star look. Price is the older ~$4.8M estimate — the Oct footage shows it already equipped, so it isn't re-read.

rods.name: Bone Rod
rods.note: x2.80 reel, 3,200 kg for $11M. Lots of players skip it and go straight to Candy Cane, but don't skip more than one rod — 'too strong' escapes waste casts.

rods.name: Candy Cane Rod
rods.note: x3.20 reel, 5,000 kg for $26M. Solid late-game value.

rods.name: Alien Rod
rods.note: x3.65 reel, 7,500 kg for $60M (Oct 4 shop).

rods.name: Royal Rod
rods.note: x4.15 reel, 12,000 kg for $140M (Oct 4 shop) — cheaper than the old ~$300M estimate.

rods.name: Hacker Rod
rods.note: x4.75 reel, 20,000 kg for $320M. It used to be the end of the ladder — now it's roughly the middle, with a dozen-plus rods above it.

rods.name: Bluesteel Rod
rods.note: x5.40 reel, 32,000 kg for $26B. The first rod past Hacker — expect a long save-up.

rods.name: Candy Rod
rods.note: x6.10 reel, 55,000 kg for $720B. Not the same as the Candy Cane Rod — this one sits much higher on the ladder.

rods.name: Egyptian Rod
rods.note: Reward from the Mummy's trials in the Sept 15–21 Desert Event: x3.00 reel (slow on purpose), 102,000 kg, and it can roll exclusive mutations. It still has a slot in the Oct shop list, but we haven't seen how to get it now.

rods.name: Lava Rod
rods.note: x6.90 reel, 90,000 kg. Sept 15 footage read its price as $45B, but the Oct 4 shop puts it after the $720B Candy Rod, so that old read is probably out of date.

rods.name: Cosmic Rod
rods.note: x7.80 reel, 150,000 kg (seen on both Sept 15 and Oct 4 footage). The old $600B read doesn't fit the Oct ladder, so the price is unconfirmed for now.

rods.name: Toy Rod
rods.note: x9.20 reel, 220,000 kg for $55T (Oct 4 shop).

rods.name: Jungle Rod
rods.note: x11.00 reel, 320,000 kg for $96T (Oct 4 shop).

rods.name: Lucky Rod
rods.note: x11.00 reel, 320,000 kg — same stats as the Jungle Rod, but you can't buy it. The shop marks it 'Spin Wheel Exclusive': win it on the spin wheel.

rods.name: Radioactive Rod
rods.note: x13.00 reel, 850,000 kg for $200T (Oct 4 shop).

rods.name: Beach Rod
rods.note: x14.50 reel, 1.3M kg for $240T. Seen on two separate Oct 4–5 videos.

rods.name: Moon Rod
rods.note: x16.00 reel, 2M kg. Only seen already owned, so the price isn't read yet.

rods.name: Frosty Rod
rods.note: x17.50 reel, 3M kg. Only seen already owned, so the price isn't read yet.

rods.name: Planet Rod
rods.note: x19.00 reel, 4.5M kg. Only seen already owned, so the price isn't read yet.

rods.name: Rainbow Godly Rod
rods.note: The top of the cash ladder right now: x20.50 reel, 6.5M kg for $10Qi. Its colors cycle. On Oct 4 a lobby pedestal was also offering it for R$160 to a player who already had the Planet Rod.

rods.name: Godly Rod
rods.note: A Robux rod sold on a lobby pedestal, not in the cash ladder: x2.00 reel, 800 kg. We've seen it at R$264 (Oct 4) and R$329 (Oct 6), so check the price in game.

rods.name: Void Ghost Rod
rods.note: A limited-stock Robux rod on a lobby pedestal: x2.20 reel, 1,400 kg. Stock showed 944/999 left on Oct 6, and the price moved from R$320 to R$399.

rods.name: Leaf Rod
rods.note: Bamboo-style rod from the September ladder. It's not in the Oct 4 shop — Golden goes straight to Cactus now — so it looks like it was removed.

rods.name: Night Rod
rods.note: Night-cycle rod creators used in September between Cactus and Tree. It's not in the Oct 4 shop (Cactus goes straight to Tree), so it looks like it was removed or renamed.

rods.name: Void Rod
rods.note: Showed up in early community notes but never in gameplay we checked, and it's not in the Oct 4 shop (Candy Cane goes straight to Alien). Treat it as not real.
